# RC Interior

> RC Interior is an office and commercial interior design-and-build company in Gurugram, Haryana, India, working across Delhi NCR since 2007. It plans, visualises in 3D and builds workplaces for companies such as Google, Samsung, Sony, TCS, SBI Card and 30+ others.

## Key facts
- Name: RC Interior
- Founded: 2007
- Based in: 5, Dhaniram Complex, Sikandarpur, Near Metro Pillar 54, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India
- Serves: Gurugram, Delhi, Noida and the wider Delhi NCR region
- Phone: +91 96504 56779 (mobile, WhatsApp), +91 124 407 3017 (office)
- Email: info@rcinterior.co.in
- Website: https://www.rcinterior.co.in
- Tagline: Your space. Your style. Your choice.

## Services
- Design & Planning: space planning, concept design, lighting plans, 3D visuals, layout designing, execution plan, material shortlisting, colour finalisation, branding elements, delivery timeline, project submission.
- Turnkey Projects: one contract, one team, one committed timeline. Civil, electrical, plumbing, flooring, structures, partitions, installation, painting, furniture placement and finishing.
- Electrical, HVAC & Fire: services behind the walls, done to code and fully documented.
- Renovation & Refurbishment: refresh a reception or rebuild a floor while the business keeps running.
- Repair & Maintenance (R&M): ongoing contracts that keep an office in handover condition.
- Expertise: corporate, retail, turnkey, renovation, MEP, R&M. Styles: modern, traditional, hybrid & sustainable.

## How a project runs
1. Consult: site visit, brief, budget and timeline, agreed in writing.
2. Design: space plans, materials and 3D visuals you can walk through.
3. Build: civil, MEP, fire safety and furniture, run by in-house site managers.
4. Handover: snag-free on the agreed date, then R&M for as long as needed.
